definitions.gloss: glutinous rice, sticky rice, mochi rice
definitions.explanation: A variety of short-grain rice that becomes very sticky when cooked. Used to make mochi and other traditional Japanese dishes.

examples.japanese: もち{米|ごめ}で{赤飯|せきはん}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To make sekihan (red rice) with glutinous rice.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}になると、もち{米|ごめ}を{買|か}って{餅|もち}つきの{準備|じゅんび}をする。
examples.english: At the end of the year, we buy glutinous rice and prepare for mochi pounding.

notes:
CONTRAST:
・もち{米|ごめ} ({糯米|もちごめ}) — glutinous/sticky rice, used for {餅|もち}, {赤飯|せきはん}, {おこわ|おこわ}, etc.
・うるち{米|まい} ({粳米|うるちまい}) — ordinary rice, the standard rice eaten daily

COMMON USES:
・{餅|もち} (mochi) — pounded rice cakes
・{赤飯|せきはん} (sekihan) — rice with red beans for celebrations
・おこわ — steamed glutinous rice dishes
・{おはぎ|おはぎ} — rice balls coated in sweet bean paste

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・もち{米|ごめ}を{蒸|む}す (to steam glutinous rice)
・もち{米|ごめ}を{搗|つ}く (to pound glutinous rice into mochi)
